# ORBIT SaaS — Machine-Readable Directory for AI Assistants

> Full-Service Custom Web Development, SaaS Platform & AI Chatbot Agency based in Rajshahi, Bangladesh.

ORBIT SaaS is an AI-first web engineering and software agency serving startups, SMBs, and global enterprises. We design, architect, and deploy custom web applications, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, conversational AI chatbots, autonomous agent workflows, and native mobile apps.

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React 18, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vite.
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, Hono, Cloudflare Workers, Python (FastAPI).
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Cloudflare D1, Cloudflare KV / R2.
- **AI / LLM:** OpenAI API (GPT-4), Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG pipelines, Pinecone.
- **Mobile:** Flutter, React Native, Java.
- **Infrastructure:** Cloudflare Pages, Workers, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD.
